widgets.title: Orders
widgets.description: Orders and revenue today and this week, and the orders waiting for a person.

page_widgets.title: Cart button
page_widgets.description: The cart icon with a count of what is in it. Opens the mini-cart, or goes to the cart page.

attributes.name: text
attributes.label: Button text
attributes.hint: Shown next to the icon. Leave empty for the icon alone.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.label: Icon
attributes.hint: Any icon the site has. Empty for no icon.

attributes.name: counter
attributes.label: Show the count
attributes.hint: The number of items in the cart, shown on the button.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.label: Inline
attributes.hint: Sits on the line with the content around it, instead of on a line of its own.

page_widgets.title: Add to cart
page_widgets.description: A quantity and an Add to cart button for one product.

attributes.name: product-id
attributes.label: Product
attributes.hint: The product this button adds to the cart. Products are made under Products in the admin.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.label: Icon
attributes.hint: Any icon the site has. Empty for no icon.

attributes.name: full
attributes.label: Full width
attributes.hint: The button fills the width of its place, instead of being as wide as its text.

attributes.name: selections
attributes.label: Options
attributes.hint: The option choices this button adds, chosen in the settings.

attributes.name: detect-parent
attributes.label: Detect the parent product
attributes.hint: Add the product, and the options chosen, of the Parent Product or Product widget this button is placed in.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.label: Inline
attributes.hint: Sits on the line with the content around it, instead of on a line of its own.

page_widgets.title: Cart
page_widgets.description: The cart page: the lines, the totals and the way on to checkout. Put the cart pieces inside it to lay it out yourself.

page_widgets.title: Cart notices
page_widgets.description: What changed or went wrong in the cart: a price that moved, a product no longer for sale. Goes inside a Cart.

page_widgets.title: Cart items
page_widgets.description: The lines of the cart with their pictures, choices, prices and quantities. Goes inside a Cart.

page_widgets.title: Cart totals
page_widgets.description: The subtotal, discounts and fees, and the total. Goes inside a Cart.

page_widgets.title: Cart buttons
page_widgets.description: Continue shopping, and on to checkout. Goes inside a Cart.

page_widgets.title: Checkout
page_widgets.description: The checkout page, ready to use. Put the checkout pieces inside it to lay it out yourself.

page_widgets.title: Checkout contact
page_widgets.description: Who the customer is, an account if one is wanted, and the details extensions ask for. Goes inside a Checkout.

page_widgets.title: Checkout billing address
page_widgets.description: The billing address, which sets the tax. Goes inside a Checkout.

page_widgets.title: Checkout credits
page_widgets.description: Store credit and credits the customer can spend, shown only when they have some. Goes inside a Checkout.

page_widgets.title: Checkout payment
page_widgets.description: The card, shown only when something is to be paid by it. Goes inside a Checkout.

page_widgets.title: Checkout extra sections
page_widgets.description: The sections other extensions add to the checkout, such as a shipping address. Goes inside a Checkout.

page_widgets.title: Checkout order summary
page_widgets.description: The order and its totals, and what extensions put under them. Goes inside a Checkout.

page_widgets.title: Checkout place order
page_widgets.description: The button that places the order, and what is still needed before it can be pressed. Goes inside a Checkout.

page_widgets.title: Order history
page_widgets.description: The signed-in customer's orders, newest first, with a link to each.

permissions.name: commerce:orders:view
permissions.description: See orders, their history, and open and abandoned carts

permissions.name: commerce:orders:manage
permissions.description: Change an order's status, add notes, mark lines fulfilled and cancel orders

permissions.name: commerce:refunds:issue
permissions.description: Refund orders. Returning card money also needs payments:refund

permissions.name: commerce:checkout
permissions.description: Check out while signed in. Held by every user from the first install, so a site can narrow it

settings.name: site_url
settings.description: The address of this site, used for the links in emails, such as http://localhost:3000

settings.name: guest_checkout
settings.description: Allow people to check out without an account. A cart with credits for sale in it always needs one

settings.name: allow_account_creation
settings.description: Offer to create an account on the checkout form. Always offered, and required, when the cart has credits for sale in it

settings.name: cart_expiry_days
settings.description: Days without a change before an open cart counts as abandoned

settings.name: cart_purge_days
settings.description: Days after a cart was abandoned before it is deleted

settings.name: max_lines_per_cart
settings.description: The most different lines one cart can have

settings.name: max_quantity_per_line
settings.description: The most of one product a customer can put on one line

settings.name: pending_expiry_minutes
settings.description: How long an order waiting for its payment holds its quantity and any credit spent on it, before it fails and everything is given back

settings.name: order_number_prefix
settings.description: Shown before every order number, such as # or INV-

settings.name: order_number_padding
settings.description: Pad order numbers with zeros to at least this many digits. 0 does not pad

settings.name: order_number_start
settings.description: The number of the first order. Changing it later only affects orders placed after

settings.name: order_number_random
settings.description: Give each order a random 8-digit number instead of 1001, 1002 and so on, so nobody can tell how many orders the shop has had or guess another order's number. The prefix still applies; the padding and first number do not

settings.name: restock_on_refund
settings.description: Whether refunded products go back into quantity by default. It can be changed for each refund

settings.name: price_floor_notice
settings.value: A discount on this order was limited by the minimum price of a product.
settings.description: Shown in the cart under the totals when a product's minimum price held a discount back, so the customer is not left wondering why it is smaller than advertised

settings.name: refund_policy
settings.description: Shown to the customer at checkout, and kept with the order as what they agreed to

settings.name: mini_cart_side
settings.description: Which side of the page the mini-cart opens from: left or right

settings.name: mini_cart_open_on_add
settings.description: Open the mini-cart when something is added to the cart

settings.name: add_to_cart_toast_action
settings.description: The "View cart" button on the confirmation shown after adding to the cart: mini-cart opens the mini-cart (or the cart page when the page has none), cart-page goes to the cart page, none shows no button

settings.name: mini_cart_inject
settings.description: Put the mini-cart on every public page. Turn off to place <k-commerce-mini-cart> yourself. The cart button is not placed for you: add the Cart item to a menu

settings.name: mini_cart_hide_on_cart_pages
settings.description: Do not show the mini-cart on the cart page itself, which shows the same thing. It is always available on the checkout page, so an item can be changed or added without leaving

settings.name: purchase_limit_per_user
settings.description: Checkout attempts one account can make in an hour. 0 turns the limit off

settings.name: purchase_limit_per_ip
settings.description: Checkout attempts one address can make in an hour. 0 turns the limit off

settings.name: purchase_limit_global
settings.description: Checkout attempts the whole site accepts in an hour. 0 turns the limit off

settings.name: failed_payment_limit
settings.description: Declined payments from one account or address, within the cool-down, before further attempts are refused. 0 turns it off

settings.name: failed_payment_cooldown_minutes
settings.description: How long declines are counted for, and how long attempts are refused once the limit is reached

settings.name: trust_proxy
settings.description: Take the visitor's address from X-Forwarded-For. Turn on only when the site is behind a proxy you run: with none, the header is whatever the visitor sent

groups.name: kempo-commerce:support
groups.description: Sees orders and carts, without changing anything

groups.name: kempo-commerce:manager
groups.description: Runs the shop: sees and manages orders, and refunds them

groups.name: kempo-commerce:administrator
groups.description: Everything: orders, refunds and the commerce settings
